value.title: Phase 1: Measure current behaviour (investigate)
value.summary: Four scripted probes, one variable each; output is the evidence contract that rules phase 2.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Investigate mode per the impl-guide: a unit is a probe, its interface is the evidence contract, its done is the receipt (with observed tool versions), composition is the ruled phase-2 unit set.

value.title: Probe harness: assets/probes/probe.sh (or .mjs) — creates a disposable worktree of this repo with a poctest- prefix, orchestrates the four probes below, captures daemon-log + DB-delta + CLI-envelope evidence per probe, tears everything down; runnable end-to-end by any future seat.
value.success: One command runs all four probes and emits per-probe transcripts.

value.title: P1 discovery + P2 incremental cost: untouched worktree (is it seen? what jobs?) then K edited files (what scans, what enqueues, what REACHES a provider — call counts from logs/DB, not inference). Distinguish blob-dedupe savings from enrichment re-emit behaviour explicitly.
value.success: Measured numbers for both probes with transcripts; provider-call count for unchanged content stated exactly.

value.title: P3 search resolution: same query from main and from inside the worktree; record which file versions rank, whether context is distinguishable in the envelope, and how ties behave. Include bobolink's case: uncommitted content in a worktree, is it findable at all?
value.success: Version-resolution behaviour documented with envelopes pasted; the uncommitted-content answer explicit.

value.title: P4 removal: git worktree remove, then measure references/GC — what becomes unreferenced, what the collector reaps on its next cycle, whether any PAID enrichment is orphaned (before/after counts).
value.success: Reference/GC deltas measured; orphaned-paid count stated (target understanding, not necessarily zero today).

value.title: The ruling artifact: assets/probe-report.md — four evidence-backed answers, the gap list, and the RULED phase-2 unit set (confirm/replace the provisional u-a..u-d) delivered to prime for sign-off before any fan-out.
value.success: Prime signs off the unit set; phase-2 tasks amended to match via ddocs.
